main_measure.name: OLS slope of 5-bar excess return on short size (-forecast/10), non-overlapping grid, pooled
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope < 0 with t <= -2 (and largest-third mean < 0); reject: slope > 0 with t >= +2

supporting_check.name: mean 5-bar excess return in the largest third of short sizes

decided_by: The slope is negative with t <= -2 and the largest-third mean excess return is below zero.
reading: The regression uses every grid bar (zero-forecast bars at short size 0) with the coin's mean taken over all its non-overlapping grid returns, and the largest third is the top floor(n/3) non-zero-forecast grid cases ranked by short size.
